scene_summary: A worn gilt Gothic triple-arch altarpiece dominates the left of the plate, its three dark crumpled panels crossed by a glowing red-and-green candlestick chart plunging from upper left to lower right. To the right, a shaggy black grinning fuzz creature is splattered onto a pale plaster wall above a black-and-cream chevron tile floor.

detected_objects.label: Gilt Gothic triple-arch altarpiece framing falling candlestick chart
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Continuous gold-leaf Gothic frame with three pointed arches, tracery, pinnacles and clustered columns enclosing dark panels; red/green candlestick strokes descend diagonally through all three apertures; the top is cropped by the image edge.
